name: bicep-parser-lenient-limits
body: The parser is lenient and unbounded: error columns are byte offsets; var, using and extends accept more than the Bicep compiler; metadata, targetScope, extension, assert and test lines are skipped unchecked; a nullable type before an operator may be misread; @export() is discarded, so an import matches any top-level type or var by name; an unclosed bracket skips to end of file, hiding later declarations; expression nesting has no depth bound. Tighten when diagnostics must match the compiler.
